description: Raw evidence validation and gating. Validates raw output records (hash integrity, required fields), audits ZIP artifacts, loads JSONL files, validates metric passports, and summarizes CSV files numerically. All operations are read-only.
function: Raw record validation, SHA-256 hashing, ZIP audit, JSONL loading, metric passport validation

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File path for sha256_file, audit_zip, summarize_csv, load_jsonl

inputs.name: model_slot
inputs.description: Model slot name for raw record

inputs.name: raw_output
inputs.description: Raw output text to store and hash

inputs.name: records
inputs.description: Batch of raw records to validate

inputs.name: scoring_done
inputs.description: Whether scoring has been executed (default False)

inputs.name: expect_cycle
inputs.description: Expected cycle number for passport validation

inputs.name: max_hash_mb
inputs.description: Max file size in MB to hash inside ZIP (default 64.0)

outputs.name: sha256_file
outputs.description: SHA-256 of file, or None if missing

outputs.name: build_raw_record
outputs.description: Raw record dict with output_hash field

outputs.name: validate_raw_records
outputs.description: Gate report dataclass for a batch

outputs.name: load_jsonl
outputs.description: List of parsed dicts from JSONL file
